Geographies Served Programs Vishnubhai Amin Orphan & Destitute and Single Parents Project State Gujarat States Gujarat Since these years ultimately mould their future, children require the greatest attention throughout this time. From 2006 till the present, United Way of Baroda has been providing annual help to over 15227 Vadodara district orphan, destitute, and single-parent children through the Vishnubhai Amin Orphan and Destitute project and Community Impact Programme. Every beneficiary receives an educational kit from us, and we also engage in year-round programming with these at-risk kids, including educational tours, festival celebrations, and other events that promote the kids' holistic growth. As part of the project, United Way of Baroda offers school bags, notebooks, lunch boxes, water bottles, pens, pencils, compass boxes, glue, and other stationery supplies in customised educational kits based on the student's grades (20 Items). Fusion Study Foundation Program More than 1200 students who participated in the Fusion Study Foundation Programme, which was established in 2005, successfully graduated or received postgraduate degrees from esteemed educational institutions over its 18-year implementation. Deserving and hardworking students from low-income families who want to pursue careers in engineering, pure sciences, applied sciences, medical science, business administration, accounting, and other fields of study can apply for interest-free loans through this programme.
